subject: Vendor continuity & migration evidence — EU nodes
messages:
From: Elena Marino <elena.marino@finservcorp.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@finservcorp.com, oliver.hsu@finservcorp.com
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Request: updated vendor roster + migration windows for EU nodes

Rishi —

Thanks for the earlier demo. As part of our vendor risk review for the EU rollout, Compliance is asking for: a current roster of subprocessors operating in EU regions, a sample operator contact matrix, and your standard notice periods for node decommissioning / region migration. We also need any supporting evidence (SOC2 section references, subprocessor change policy, and a CSV roster preferred).

Can you provide the pack and confirm whether Redwood provides assisted migration support (engineering hours/contacts) when a customer has to move off an operator due to a change of subprocessor?

We'd like to have this by next Friday so we can include it in the Procurement packet.

Elena Marino
Compliance Manager
FinServCorp

--

Subject: Re: Request: updated vendor roster + migration windows for EU nodes

Elena —

Appreciate the clear ask. I've pulled together an evidence pack and attached a CSV roster and our current change policy. Quick notes up front:
- Vendor roster attached lists operators that handle EU traffic today and the services they perform.
- Standard decommission/notice policy is 30 days for non-emergency operator removals; for planned migrations we document transition SLAs and will provide a migration runbook and 2 weeks of dedicated engineering overlap when agreed in contract.
- We can offer extended hands-on migration support as a paid services add-on (scope varies by region/account).

Attachments: vendor_roster_eu_20261210.csv; subprocessor-change-policy.pdf

If helpful I can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough next week to talk through the roster and the operator contacts.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2026 11:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: updated vendor roster + migration windows for EU nodes

Rishi —

Reviewed. Short answers:
- SOC2: reference "System and Organization Controls — Security" (controls related to third-party management) and the relevant sections in our SOC2 Type II report are 4.2 (vendor management) and 5.1 (change control). We do not re-issue per-customer SOC2s but can provide the certified report under NDA.
- Operator roster: current EU operators (high level): AWS (eu-west-1), GCP (europe-west1 & europe-west2), a regional infra partner (EUDX Operators Ltd) handling edge delivery for specific EU customers, and a managed caching partner (CacheCo EU). I've attached a one-off operator contact CSV that has on-call emails and escalation phone numbers for EU operators.
- Migration support: Ops confirms the 30-day standard notice for forced removals (emergency) and 30-day planned decommission is our default. The two-week overlap is offered as a standard courtesy for enterprise customers in the EU (no separate paid SKU required) — but we need agreement on the change freeze window and a runbook sign-off.

I've attached "eu-infra-operator-list.csv" with the contact matrix and added comments where manual coordination is required (regional legal checks, data egress approvals).

-Karthik
Head of Security & Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Rishi / Karthik / Laura —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. Procurement and Compliance have reviewed the roster and operator matrix. Two requests before we close the packet:
1) Can you replace the generic 30-day decommission wording with an explicit 30-day *minimum* notice and include a small SLA clause that Redwood will provide a migration contact for 14 calendar days overlap post-notice? We want that language in writing for our Procurement team.
2) Please upload the SOC2 Type II report to the shared Drive link you provided and confirm redaction policy for customer-specific logs.

I've attached our RFI tracker with the request noted (FinServ-RFI-tracker-20261218.xlsx). We'll also need a signed DocuSign acceptance for the migration assistance wording; I've included the link to the DocuSign packet in the tracker.

Happy to take a 20-minute call if any of the requested wording needs to be discussed.

Elena Marino
